30A beach house rental Casa Brisa located in Inlet Beach, FL by Panhandle Getaways is a 4 bedroom, 3.5 bathroom vacation home complete with all of the conveniences of home. Round of golf each day of your stay included.


A spacious beach house in Inlet Beach, Casa Brisa is warm and inviting with comfortable living areas, screened porch, and four bedrooms--room for everyone! You'll love the gourmet kitchen and the grill in the backyard, not to mention all that 30A offers is just a short ride away. Get to the beach in minutes, too!

Free Activities Included. see details below***


FEATURES
* 30A Beach House 
* Living Area with 50" Smart TV
* Screened-in Back Porch with Seating
* Kitchen w/Breakfast Bar  
* Gourmet Kitchen features Quartz Countertops & High-end Appliances (potfiller, gas range, convection microwave) 
* Cuisinart 12-cup Programmable Coffee Maker w/Thermal Carafe
* Dining Area
* 2nd Living Area w/65" Smart TV - Upstairs Landing Area
* Half Bathroom on Main Level
* Bedroom 1 - King Bed, 50" Smart TV (Main Level)
* Bathroom 1 - En-Suite - Walk In Shower with Double Shower Head
* Bedroom 2 - Queen Bed, 40" Smart TV 
* Bathroom 2 - Jack n Jill with Tub/Shower Combo
* Bedroom 3 - Queen Bed, 40" Smart TV
* Bathroom 3 - Tub/Shower Combo
* Bedroom 4 - Bunk Bed (Twin/Twin/Twin Trundle) 
* Fabulous Community
* Washer / Dryer
* Spacious Paved Patio with Grill in Backyard
* Outdoor Shower - Hot and Cold Water
* FREE Wi-Fi
* Sleeps 9

Surveillance Device - This home has a Ring Camera at the front door.

Note: This home is NOT pet friendly, Allergen Free Home


Inlet Beach Access - 0.9 miles away
30A Avenue - 0.5 miles away
Rosemary Beach - 1.2 miles away

 
ABOUT THE PRESERVE AT INLET BEACH 
The Preserve at Inlet Beach in Inlet Beach, FL is a coastal community just a short bike ride to beach access. Guests will enjoy the community pool with pavilion and outdoor fireplace. The community wooden boardwalk & dock provides direct access to Lake Powell, providing quick and easy launching of paddleboards and kayaks. 


COMMUNITY AMENITIES
Community Pool with Expansive Pool Deck
Pavilion with Outdoor Fireplace
Lake Powell Access - Enjoy Paddleboarding and Kayaking 
Nature Trailes
Dining and Shopping Close By
Short Bike Ride to Beach Access
Inlet Beach


Bonus***Guests receive 1 free daily admission to some of our favorite local attractions through our partnership with Xplorie. All perks are valid for stays up to 27 days and are subject to change and availability. BONUS PERKS INCLUDED WITH YOUR STAY:

* 1 FREE Round of Golf at 1 of 4 Golf Courses in the area Every Day - Year Round
* 4 Bikes - Ready to Go at the Home - Year Round
* 1 FREE Voucher to use for an unforgettable Dolphin Cruise and/or Snorkel trip Each Day! (Mar-Oct)


INITIAL SUPPLIES - UPON ARRIVAL
Panhandle Getaways furnishes a few essential items for guests to utilize until they can get to the grocery store. Initial Supplies include: Dishwasher soap, small washing machine powder, each bathroom has amenities (like hotel but NOT restocked) shampoo, conditioner, soap bar. One roll of toilet paper in each bathroom and one paper towel roll in the kitchen. All bed linens and towels are provided. We encourage guests to bring beach towels for use at the pool and beach.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
